name: Riggs Hotel Washington DC
insider_take: Step into history at this former bank turned luxury sanctuary in the heart of Penn Quarter.
whats_special: The Riggs Hotel occupies the historic Riggs National Bank building, where presidents and dignitaries once conducted business. The stunning Art Deco architecture features the original 1891 bank vault, now transformed into a unique cocktail bar called Silver Lyan. The hotel's location places you steps from the National Mall and Smithsonian museums.
pro_tip: Book a drink at Silver Lyan during happy hour to experience cocktails served inside the original bank vault – it's Instagram gold and a conversation starter you won't find anywhere else.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop bar offers unparalleled views of the Washington Monument and Capitol Building. Take the complimentary historical building tour to learn about the secret tunnels that once connected the bank to the U.S. Treasury, and don't skip Café Riggs for their locally-sourced weekend brunch.
pros: Historic bank building with unique architectural charm and character
Prime downtown location near White House and major attractions
Luxury boutique atmosphere with personalized service
Sophisticated dining and bar offerings on-site
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury DC hotels
Limited parking availability in downtown location
